'''Jeremy Arak'''<ref name="dt-13414">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13414 Court of the Vile Skum], DeckTech (Jeremy "BoShek007" Arak, 5 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13414/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13414/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018060645/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13414/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''BoShek007''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court Of The Vile Gangster]] list on DeckTech in February 2001.
